component.name: OpenModel-Manager
component.summary: Run local AI models: chat, agent, images and video

description.p: Open-source manager for local AI models. It checks what your hardware can run, downloads models and inference engines (llama.cpp, stable-diffusion.cpp, Strata, vLLM), plans GPU / RAM / disk placement, and gives you chat, an agent with backend-enforced tool approval, and image and video generation. No telemetry.
